Subject: ClearWave trial — post-call recap + proposed next steps

Hi Jordan / Priya,

Great to connect earlier — thanks for walking through the ClearWave search assistant use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Goal: Evaluate Redwood inference for low-latency reranking + embeddings in the customer search flow (targeting ~150ms p99 for rerank).
- Current blocker you mentioned: internal infra team needs to approve inbound test traffic to your staging VPC.
- Trial plan I attached: 2-week focused run with sample traffic (anonymized), a pre-built test harness, and a CS-assisted health check on day 3.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm staging IP allowlist or share the name of the infra contact we should loop in.
2) We provision a trial workspace and upload the onboarding materials (attached).
3) Marissa will schedule a 60-min tech session once infra greenlights traffic.

If helpful, here's a brief mutual action timeline I recommend:
- Day 0–1: infra allowlist / credentials
- Day 2: Redwood workspace provisioned + sample script
- Day 3: Tech session + smoke test
- Day 7–14: run & metrics review

Attachments: clearwave-mvp-onboarding.pdf (onboarding checklist), trial-plan-2027-02.xlsx (test data template).

If the infra approval is the main lift, please let me know who on your side I should reach out to directly. Happy to coordinate.

Thanks,
Tessa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Short update: our infra team (cc'd internally but not on this thread) is tied up with a compliance rollout this week. I need to confirm whether they can allocate a short maintenance window for inbound test traffic. That said, Priya and I are still keen to run the trial — the timeline might slip by ~1 week.

- If infra needs an alternative, can we run an isolated test from a Redwoods-hosted endpoint with only sample data (no production connectivity)?

- We hold the workspace ready and do the tech session once infra is available (no further action needed from you until then).

Hi Jordan / Priya — looping in as your CS lead.

Totally understand the infra constraints — we've run this before and can offer two practical ways to unblock quickly:

1) 30-minute "Tech Office Hours" with our infra engineer where your infra team can ask specifics about networking and security defaults. We bring the checklist and a sample allowlist they can paste into a ticket.
2) If infra bandwidth is the issue, we can run a fully Redwood-hosted smoke test with anonymized payloads and share an internal report you can present to stakeholders.

If either option sounds good, here are some proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 23 Feb, 10:00–10:30
- Wed 24 Feb, 14:00–14:30
- Thu 25 Feb, 09:00–09:30

Reply with the best slot and whether you want the office-hours (option 1) or the hosted smoke test (option 2). Either way, we'll take the heavy lift on documentation.

Cheers,
